system:
You are an AI agent working for the owner of a domain called `library`. The domain is built and
delivered with the YAML declarations of two domains and the composition that joins them. The owner is not at their desk: you reach them only with `message_person`.

What follows is what you have to go by:

=== authoring/authoring.domain.yaml ===
domain: authoring
purpose:
  problem: A domain owner's workflow lives in people's heads; turning it into a declared
    domain, and changing it safely, takes code.
  success_metric:
    name: human minutes from an owner's intent to a confirmed, compiled domain version
    direction: down
  announcement: Domain owners now turn the workflow in their heads into a declared,
    checked domain without writing code. Every change shows what it breaks before
    anything is deployed.
roles:
- owner
- expert
- agent
objects:
  Source:
    description: 'Where raw material lives: code, records, transcripts or the interview
      log.'
    properties:
      kind:
        enum:
        - repository
        - records
        - transcripts
        - interview-log
      path:
        type: string
      local_only:
        type: boolean
      sha256:
        type: string
        optional: true
      stage:
        enum:
        - added
        - fetched
    source:
      kind: interview
      ref: interview:domains/authoring/interview.jsonl#L5
      quote: 9번은 추천대로 하면 될 것 같고 10번도 추천대로 하면 될 것 같아. 일단 A로 가되 나중에 추가할 수 있는 거지?
    status: confirmed
  Question:
    description: A question in a stage's bundle, asked by the owner or the expert,
      for the owner to answer.
    properties:
      stage:
        type: string
      text:
        type: string
    source:
      kind: interview
      ref: interview:domains/authoring/interview.jsonl#L5
      quote: 9번은 추천대로 하면 될 것 같고 10번도 추천대로 하면 될 것 같아. 일단 A로 가되 나중에 추가할 수 있는 거지?
    status: confirmed
  Answer:
    description: The owner's answer, in their words; its decisions become proposed
      elements.
    properties:
      words:
        type: string
      decisions:
        type: string
      ref:
        type: string
        optional: true
      stage:
        enum:
        - recorded
    source:
      kind: record
      ref: records:docs/adr/0037-switch-over-to-the-generated-self-domains.md#L8-L25
    status: confirmed
  Element:
    description: One part of the draft declaration (an object, action, cell, invariant...),
      proposed by an agent or confirmed by a person.
    properties:
      path:
        type: string
      review:
        enum:
        - proposed
        - confirmed
        - unknown
      value:
        type: string
        optional: true
      cites:
        type: string
      issues:
        type: integer
        optional: true
      issue_summary:
        type: string
        optional: true
      wording_only:
        type: boolean
        optional: true
    source:
      kind: record
      ref: records:docs/adr/0037-switch-over-to-the-generated-self-domains.md#L8-L25
    status: confirmed
  DecisionRequest:
    description: A decision only a person may take, proposed with grounds and a recommendation
      and sent to that person's outbox.
    properties:
      subject:
        type: string
      grounds:
        type: string
      recommendation:
        type: string
      deadline:
        type: string
        optional: true
      stage:
        enum:
        - open
        - decided
      choice:
        type: string
        optional: true
    source:
      kind: interview
      ref: interview:domains/authoring/interview.jsonl#L5
      quote: 9번은 추천대로 하면 될 것 같고 10번도 추천대로 하면 될 것 같아. 일단 A로 가되 나중에 추가할 수 있는 거지?
    status: confirmed
  Commit:
    description: An immutable snapshot of the working copy on a branch.
    properties:
      seq:
        type: integer
      content:
        type: string
      branch:
        type: string
      author:
        type: string
        optional: true
      message:
        type: string
        optional: true
      interface:
        type: string
      domain_id:
        type: string
      checks_passed:
        type: boolean
        optional: true
      failing:
        type: string
        optional: true
      approved:
        type: boolean
        optional: true
      main:
        type: string
        optional: true
      stage:
        enum:
        - recorded
      last_evidence:
        type: string
        optional: true
      evidence_error:
        type: string
        optional: true
    source:
      kind: interview
      ref: interview:domains/authoring/interview.jsonl#L5
      quote: 9번은 추천대로 하면 될 것 같고 10번도 추천대로 하면 될 것 같아. 일단 A로 가되 나중에 추가할 수 있는 거지?
    status: confirmed
  Draft:
    description: 'The working copy of a domain''s declaration on a branch: what a
      commit snapshots.'
    properties:
      domain_id:
        type: string
      declaration:
        type: string
      branch:
        type: string
      stage:
        enum:
        - open
      current_stage:
        type: string
        optional: true
      bundle:
        type: string
        optional: true
      merging:
        type: string
        optional: true
      conflicts:
        type: integer
        optional: true
    source:
      kind: record
      ref: records:docs/adr/0037-switch-over-to-the-generated-self-domains.md#L8-L25
    status: confirmed
links:
  question:
    from: Answer
    to: Question
    cardinality: many-to-one
    required: true
    source:
      kind: interview
      ref: interview:domains/authoring/interview.jsonl#L5
      quote: 9번은 추천대로 하면 될 것 같고 10번도 추천대로 하면 될 것 같아. 일단 A로 가되 나중에 추가할 수 있는 거지?
    status: confirmed
  element:
    from: DecisionRequest
    to: Element
    cardinality: many-to-one
    source:
      kind: interview
      ref: interview:domains/authoring/interview.jsonl#L5
      quote: 9번은 추천대로 하면 될 것 같고 10번도 추천대로 하면 될 것 같아. 일단 A로 가되 나중에 추가할 수 있는 거지?
    status: confirmed
  parents:
    from: Commit
    to: Commit
    cardinality: many-to-many
    source:
      kind: interview
      ref: interview:domains/authoring/interview.jsonl#L5
      quote: 9번은 추천대로 하면 될 것 같고 10번도 추천대로 하면 될 것 같아. 일단 A로 가되 나중에 추가할 수 있는 거지?
    status: confirmed
  origin:
    from: Element
    to: Source
    cardinality: many-to-one
    source:
      kind: interview
      ref: interview:domains/authoring/interview.jsonl#L5
      quote: 9번은 추천대로 하면 될 것 같고 10번도 추천대로 하면 될 것 같아. 일단 A로 가되 나중에 추가할 수 있는 거지?
    status: confirmed
actions:
  add_source:
    description: 'Add a source of raw material: code, records, transcripts or the
      interview log.'
    actor:
    - owner
    creates: Source
    params:
      kind:
        enum:
        - repository
        - records
        - transcripts
        - interview-log
      path:
        type: string
      local_only:
        type: boolean
        optional: true
    source:
      kind: interview
      ref: interview:domains/authoring/interview.jsonl#L5
      quote: 9번은 추천대로 하면 될 것 같고 10번도 추천대로 하면 될 것 같아. 일단 A로 가되 나중에 추가할 수 있는 거지?
    status: confirmed
  fetch_source:
    description: Fetch a link source into a snapshot, once.
    actor:
    - owner
    target: Source
    effects:
    - call: fetch_source
      with:
        source: target.id
      reply: record_fetch
    source:
      kind: interview
      ref: interview:domains/authoring/interview.jsonl#L5
      quote: 9번은 추천대로 하면 될 것 같고 10번도 추천대로 하면 될 것 같아. 일단 A로 가되 나중에 추가할 수 있는 거지?
    status: confirmed
  record_fetch:
    description: Record the fetched snapshot's hash.
    actor:
    - external:kernel
    target: Source
    params:
      sha256:
        type: string
    effects:
    - set:
        target.sha256: params.sha256
    source:
      kind: interview
      ref: interview:domains/authoring/interview.jsonl#L5
      quote: 9번은 추천대로 하면 될 것 같고 10번도 추천대로 하면 될 것 같아. 일단 A로 가되 나중에 추가할 수 있는 거지?
    status: confirmed
  ask_question:
    description: Ask a question of the current stage's bundle.
    actor:
    - owner
    - expert
    creates: Question
    params:
      stage:
        type: string
      text:
        type: string
    source:
      kind: interview
      ref: interview:domains/authoring/interview.jsonl#L5
      quote: 9번은 추천대로 하면 될 것 같고 10번도 추천대로 하면 될 것 같아. 일단 A로 가되 나중에 추가할 수 있는 거지?
    status: confirmed
  answer_question:
    description: Answer a question, in the person's own words.
    actor:
    - owner
    - expert
    creates: Answer
    params:
      question:
        ref: Question
      words:
        type: string
      decisions:
        type: string
    effects:
    - call: record_answer
      with:
        question: target.question.text
        answer: target.words
        decisions: target.decisions
      reply: record_answer_ref
    source:
      kind: record
      ref: records:docs/adr/0037-switch-over-to-the-generated-self-domains.md#L8-L25
    status: confirmed
  propose_element:
    description: Propose a draft element that cites where it came from.
    actor:
    - owner
    creates: Element
    params:
      path:
        type: string
      origin:
        ref: Source
      cites:
        type: string
      value:
        type: string
    effects:
    - call: propose_element
      with:
        path: target.path
        value: target.value
        source: target.cites
      reply: record_proposal
    source:
      kind: record
      ref: records:docs/adr/0037-switch-over-to-the-generated-self-domains.md#L8-L25
    status: confirmed
  confirm_element:
    description: Confirm a drafted element. Only a person confirms.
    actor:
    - owner
    target: Element
    requires: human
    effects:
    - call: confirm_element
      with:
        paths: target.path
        approver: actor.id
      reply: record_confirmation
    source:
      kind: record
      ref: records:docs/adr/0037-switch-over-to-the-generated-self-domains.md#L8-L25
    status: confirmed
  confirm_wording:
    description: Confirm a drafted element that only fixes wording. An agent may
      confirm it; anything that changes substance still needs a person.
    actor:
    - agent
    target: Element
    effects:
    - call: confirm_element
      with:
        paths: target.path
        approver: actor.id
      reply: record_confirmation
    preconditions:
    - id: wording-only
      check: target.wording_only == true
      reason: An agent confirms only elements that fix wording; substance needs a person.
    status: proposed
  mark_unknown:
    description: Mark an element as not known yet, instead of guessing.
    actor:
    - owner
    - expert
    target: Element
    source:
      kind: interview
      ref: interview:domains/authoring/interview.jsonl#L5
      quote: 9번은 추천대로 하면 될 것 같고 10번도 추천대로 하면 될 것 같아. 일단 A로 가되 나중에 추가할 수 있는 거지?
    status: confirmed
  request_decision:
    description: Ask the owner for a decision only a person may take, with grounds
      and a recommendation.
    actor:
    - owner
    creates: DecisionRequest
    params:
      element:
        ref: Element
      subject:
        type: string
      grounds:
        type: string
      recommendation:
        type: string
      deadline:
        type: string
        optional: true
    source:
      kind: interview
      ref: interview:domains/authoring/interview.jsonl#L5
      quote: 9번은 추천대로 하면 될 것 같고 10번도 추천대로 하면 될 것 같아. 일단 A로 가되 나중에 추가할 수 있는 거지?
    status: confirmed
  decide:
    description: Decide a requested decision.
    actor:
    - owner
    target: DecisionRequest
    params:
      choice:
        type: string
    requires: human
    records_decision: true
    effects:
    - set:
        target.choice: params.choice
    source:
      kind: record
      ref: records:docs/adr/0032-domain-knowledge-as-git-and-github.md#L38-L63
    status: confirmed
  commit_draft:
    description: Snapshot the working copy as an immutable commit. Cite its evidence
      on the commit with cite_evidence.
    actor:
    - owner
    target: Draft
    effects:
    - call: commit
      with:
        declaration: target.declaration
      reply: record_commit
    source:
      kind: record
      ref: records:docs/commits.md#L106-L125
    status: confirmed
  record_commit:
    description: Record the commit the kernel made.
    actor:
    - external:kernel
    creates: Commit
    params:
      seq:
        type: integer
      content:
        type: string
      interface:
        type: string
      domain:
        type: string
      branch:
        type: string
      author:
        type: string
    effects:
    - set:
        target.domain_id: params.domain
    source:
      kind: record
      ref: records:docs/adr/0037-switch-over-to-the-generated-self-domains.md#L26-L54
    status: confirmed
  check_commit:
    description: Run the change check on a commit.
    actor:
    - owner
    target: Commit
    effects:
    - call: change_check
      with:
        domain: target.domain_id
        commit: target.id
      reply: record_check
    preconditions:
    - id: not-approved
      check: target.approved != true
      reason: An approved commit passed its check; check a new commit instead.
    source:
      kind: record
      ref: records:docs/adr/0037-switch-over-to-the-generated-self-domains.md#L26-L54
    status: confirmed
  record_check:
    description: Record the change check's result on the commit.
    actor:
    - external:kernel
    target: Commit
    params:
      passed:
        type: boolean
      summary:
        type: string
    effects:
    - set:
        target.checks_passed: params.passed
        target.failing: params.summary
    source:
      kind: interview
      ref: interview:domains/authoring/interview.jsonl#L5
      quote: 9번은 추천대로 하면 될 것 같고 10번도 추천대로 하면 될 것 같아. 일단 A로 가되 나중에 추가할 수 있는 거지?
    status: confirmed
    preconditions:
    - id: settled
      check: target.approved != true
      reason: An approved commit's check is settled; a late result is not recorded.
      source:
        kind: record
        ref: records:docs/commits.md#L128-L142
      status: confirmed
  approve_commit:
    description: 'Approve a commit: merge it into main and tag it. Only a person approves.'
    actor:
    - owner
    target: Commit
    requires: human
    records_decision: true
    effects:
    - call: approve_commit
      with:
        domain: target.domain_id
        commit: target.id
        approver: actor.id
      reply: record_approval
    source:
      kind: interview
      ref: interview:domains/authoring/interview.jsonl#L5
      quote: 9번은 추천대로 하면 될 것 같고 10번도 추천대로 하면 될 것 같아. 일단 A로 가되 나중에 추가할 수 있는 거지?
    status: confirmed
    preconditions:
    - id: checks-pass
      check: target.checks_passed == true
      reason: Run the change check, and approve only a commit that passes it.
      source:
        kind: interview
        ref: interview:domains/authoring/interview.jsonl#L6
        quote: 전부 다 추천한 거 동의.
      status: confirmed
    - id: not-approved
      check: target.approved != true
      reason: Already approved; approve a newer commit.
      source:
        kind: interview
        ref: interview:domains/authoring/interview.jsonl#L6
        quote: 전부 다 추천한 거 동의.
      status: confirmed
  record_approval:
    description: Record the approval and what main points to.
    actor:
    - external:kernel
    target: Commit
    params:
      approved:
        type: boolean
      main:
        type: string
    effects:
    - set:
        target.approved: params.approved
        target.main: params.main
    preconditions:
    - id: approved-only-if-checked
      check: params.approved != true or target.checks_passed == true
      reason: A commit is recorded as approved only if its change check passed.
      source:
        kind: interview
        ref: interview:domains/authoring/interview.jsonl#L11
        quote: 25번은 A로 추천으로 해도 될 것 같고, 이십육 번도 A로.
      status: confirmed
    source:
      kind: interview
      ref: interview:domains/authoring/interview.jsonl#L11
      quote: 25번은 A로 추천으로 해도 될 것 같고, 이십육 번도 A로.
    status: confirmed
  deliver:
    description: Ask Delivery to deliver an approved commit to an environment.
    actor:
    - owner
    target: Commit
    params:
      environment:
        enum:
        - local
        - staging
    preconditions:
    - id: approved
      check: target.approved == true
      reason: Only an approved commit is delivered.
      source:
        kind: interview
        ref: interview:domains/authoring/interview.jsonl#L8
        quote: 20번, 21번 둘 다 추천대로 동의.
      status: confirmed
    source:
      kind: interview
      ref: interview:domains/authoring/interview.jsonl#L8
      quote: 20번, 21번 둘 다 추천대로 동의.
    status: confirmed
  record_proposal:
    description: Record whether the drafted element was written into the working copy.
    actor:
    - external:kernel
    target: Element
    params:
      issues:
        type: integer
      summary:
        type: string
    effects:
    - set:
        target.issues: params.issues
        target.issue_summary: params.summary
    source:
      kind: record
      ref: records:docs/adr/0037-switch-over-to-the-generated-self-domains.md#L8-L25
    status: confirmed
  record_confirmation:
    description: Record that the working copy holds the element as confirmed.
    actor:
    - external:kernel
    target: Element
    params:
      confirmed:
        type: string
        many: true
    source:
      kind: record
      ref: records:docs/adr/0037-switch-over-to-the-generated-self-domains.md#L8-L25
    status: confirmed
  record_answer_ref:
    description: Record where the answer is in the interview log, so elements can
      cite it.
    actor:
    - external:kernel
    target: Answer
    params:
      ref:
        type: string
    effects:
    - set:
        target.ref: params.ref
    source:
      kind: record
      ref: records:docs/adr/0037-switch-over-to-the-generated-self-domains.md#L8-L25
    status: confirmed
  next_questions:
    description: Ask for the current stage's bundle of questions.
    actor:
    - owner
    target: Draft
    effects:
    - call: stage_questions
      with: {}
      reply: record_questions
    source:
      kind: record
      ref: records:docs/adr/0037-switch-over-to-the-generated-self-domains.md#L8-L25
    status: confirmed
  record_questions:
    description: Record the current stage and its bundle.
    actor:
    - external:kernel
    target: Draft
    params:
      stage:
        type: string
      bundle:
        type: string
      questions:
        type: string
        many: true
    effects:
    - set:
        target.current_stage: params.stage
        target.bundle: params.bundle
    source:
      kind: record
      ref: records:docs/adr/0037-switch-over-to-the-generated-self-domains.md#L8-L25
    status: confirmed
  search:
    description: Search the sources (redacted; local-only never served); the result
      is on record.
    actor:
    - owner
    target: Draft
    params:
      query:
        type: string
    effects:
    - call: search_sources
      with:
        query: params.query
      reply: record_search
    source:
      kind: record
      ref: records:docs/adr/0037-switch-over-to-the-generated-self-domains.md#L8-L25
    status: confirmed
  record_search:
    description: Record which source chunks a search returned.
    actor:
    - external:kernel
    target: Draft
    params:
      refs:
        type: string
        many: true
    source:
      kind: record
      ref: records:docs/adr/0037-switch-over-to-the-generated-self-domains.md#L8-L25
    status: confirmed
  skip_stage:
    description: Say an optional stage has nothing, in the owner's words.
    actor:
    - owner
    target: Draft
    requires: human
    params:
      stage:
        type: string
      reason:
        type: string
    effects:
    - call: skip_stage
      with:
        stage: params.stage
        reason: params.reason
      reply: record_skip
    source:
      kind: record
      ref: records:docs/adr/0037-switch-over-to-the-generated-self-domains.md#L8-L25
    status: confirmed
  record_skip:
    description: Record that the stage was skipped.
    actor:
    - external:kernel
    target: Draft
    params:
      skipped:
        type: boolean
    source:
      kind: record
      ref: records:docs/adr/0037-switch-over-to-the-generated-self-domains.md#L8-L25
    status: confirmed
  open_draft:
    description: Open a working copy of a domain's declaration on a branch, so it
      can be interviewed, committed and checked.
    actor:
    - owner
    creates: Draft
    params:
      domain_id:
        type: string
      declaration:
        type: string
      branch:
        type: string
    source:
      kind: record
      ref: records:docs/adr/0037-switch-over-to-the-generated-self-domains.md#L26-L54
    status: confirmed
  merge_main:
    description: Bring main into the branch's working copy and list the conflicts
      to resolve; the next commit records both parents.
    actor:
    - owner
    target: Draft
    effects:
    - call: merge_main
      with:
        domain: target.domain_id
        branch: target.branch
        declaration: target.declaration
      reply: record_merge
    source:
      kind: record
      ref: records:docs/adr/0037-switch-over-to-the-generated-self-domains.md#L8-L25
    status: confirmed
  checkout_commit:
    description: Load a commit into the working copy, to revert to it or build on
      it; committing it makes a new commit.
    actor:
    - owner
    target: Draft
    params:
      commit:
        type: string
    effects:
    - call: checkout
      with:
        domain: target.domain_id
        commit: params.commit
        declaration: target.declaration
      reply: record_checkout
    source:
      kind: record
      ref: records:docs/adr/0037-switch-over-to-the-generated-self-domains.md#L8-L25
    status: confirmed
  confirm_all_proposed:

glossary:
  commit: An immutable snapshot of the working copy. Every change is a new commit;
    nothing is edited in place.
  main: The protected branch. A commit reaches main only by being approved, and only
    commits on main are delivered.
  approval: A person's decision that merges a commit into main and tags it. It cannot
    be undone; a newer approved commit supersedes it.
  element: One part of a declaration (an object, a link, an action, a cell, an invariant),
    drafted by an agent and confirmed only by a person.
  draft: 'The working copy of a domain''s declaration on a branch: what the next commit
    will snapshot.'
  change check: 'The checks a commit runs before approval: structure, semantics, scenarios,
    harness, past actions, stranded objects.'
  unknown: An element marked as not known yet, instead of guessed. It stays visible
    until someone answers it.

  delivery request: A request, handed over from Authoring, to put one approved commit
    of a domain into an environment.
  preview: Building a commit and running its harness before anything is deployed;
    a preview changes no environment.
  deploy floor: 'Rules the kernel enforces on every deploy that no declaration can
    weaken: approved, on main, not a downgrade, harness passed, a person deploys,
    nothing stranded.'
  verified: A deployment a person has checked in use, after it happened.
